fit.intro: Here’s your honest fit check, based only on the official course page:

points.title: Made for students & freshers
points.text: The page’s promise to students & freshers is “Graduate with proof, not just marks.” It lists “Build a portfolio of working AI products” and “Turn projects into case studies and demos”.

points.title: For an AI job or internship
points.text: The page says the course helps you “Understand the stack behind AI job descriptions” and build a portfolio. Honest note: it does not promise a job or placement, and “commercial results still depend on your execution, market and customer acquisition.”

points.title: No coding background? You can still start
points.text: The page says: “The course starts with AI, product and development foundations before moving into full-stack apps, RAG, MCP, agents and production. points.title: Your time matches what the page asks
points.text: The page asks for people who “can commit a few focused hours each week”. Access lasts 3 months from activation, so a steady weekly routine helps.
